data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused entirely by tool failures. The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error when auditing the PKGBUILD, and the openrouter model failed to parse the LLM's response format. Neither failure reflected a security ambiguity in the package.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit PKGBUILD due to an HTTP 400 API error.
openrouter/free failed to parse the decision from the model response for PKGBUILD.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) to prevent a single model failure from resulting in an inconclusive package verdict.
Improve the response parser to be more resilient to variations in LLM output formatting, such as handling plain text safety declarations when structured tags are missing.
